text: {"covered":[{"point_id":"q2a_number_of_blocks","quote":"Number of blocks = 10 / 4 = 2.5, so we round up to 3 blocks."},{"point_id":"q2a_allocation","quote":"Block 1 is 4 KB full, block 2 is 4 KB full and block 3 has 2 KB used and 2 KB free."},{"point_id":"q2a_unused_space","quote":"Total allocated is 12 KB so the unused space is 2 KB."},{"point_id":"q2a_reason","quote":"This space is wasted because a block is the smallest unit of allocation and cannot be shared with another file, which is internal fragmentation."},{"point_id":"q2b_seek","quote":"Seek moves the file pointer or disk head to a location so that the next read or write happens there; it does not transfer data"},{"point_id":"q2b_read","quote":"Read transfers data from secondary storage into main memory from the current pointer position and then advances the pointer."},{"point_id":"q2c_update","quote":"Update changes the contents of an existing record while it remains in the file, for example changing a phone number or a balance."},{"point_id":"q2c_delete","quote":"Delete removes an entire record from storage so that it no longer exists, for example removing the record of a student who has withdrawn."}]}
